content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: ILB health / cross-region routing errors detected for Private VPCs in eu-west1 -> us-east1 paths. 5xx spike + TCP resets. Pager sent to oncall.
michelle: I'm on it, paging in. getting the alert details now. which customers affected?
jamie-cs: seeing a couple of enterprise Private VPCs reporting increased 502/504s in EU. customers: 'acme-analytics', 'bluefin-pay'. CS already hit out to their CSMs.
raj: pulling LB logs and agent traces. initial look: backend healthchecks failing intermittently, and GCP ILB control-plane shows increased 503s to our auth proxy.
kevin: I can grab packet-level info. hypothesis: third-party auth proxy (external IDP token introspect) returning errors, causing the proxy to close upstream connections.
sara: observability vendor (third-party telemetry) also has a partial outage in eu-west1 -> API timeouts around 12:03 UTC according to their status. could be correlated.
michelle: timeline: spike at 12:03 -> healthcheck failures -> ILB started draining some backends -> cross-region routing fallback fired -> clients to privatevpc eu saw timeouts.
raj: running quick query:
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=ilb AND severity>=ERROR" --limit 50 --project=redwood-prod
```
found repeated errors:
```
"upstream_error":"oauth_introspect_error: 503 Service Unavailable"
"connection_reset": true
"region":"eu-west1"
```
kevin: checked tcpdump on one failing frontend: lots of TCP RSTs after HTTP/1.1 503 from auth-proxy.
michelle: mitigation plan proposal:
- route traffic for affected customers to the nearest compatible regional pool (force us-east1) for 30m
- enable temporary auth proxy bypass for Private VPCs with explicit allowlist to keep sessions running
- open ticket with observability vendor and IDP
- notify customers via CS
raj: to route: we can create a policy rule in the controlplane to pin these customer subnets to us-east1. I'll prepare the rollout and a canary set first.
kevin: to enable bypass we need to update ILB proxy config. snippet:
```json
{"auth": {"mode":"fallback","allowlist": ["proj-acme-123", "proj-blue-987"]}}
```
sara: FYI vendor status: https://status.telemetryx.com/incidents/AB123 - looks like partial API rate-limiting in eu-west1. they're also reporting higher error rates at the same window.
jamie-cs: telling customers now: short note sent to Acme's CSM: "We're seeing transient routing issues between eu-west1 and us-east1 affecting Private VPCs; we're implementing routing fallbacks and will update in 30m." they asked for ETA.
michelle: ETA 30-45m to confirm stable after traffic pin and bypass. executing change in 2m. raj, KEVIN, confirm readiness for rollback.
raj: I have a rollback plan: revert routing policy and revert auth-mode to strict. ready. will monitor metrics (5xx rate, p50/p95 latency) and ILB health counts.
kevin: I have a script to toggle proxy config and roll back a change automatically if error budget exceeds 0.5% in 5m.
oncall-bot: michelle was assigned the incident and is the primary responder. handoff note scheduled at +2h. :white_check_mark:
michelle: applying canary now to 5% of acme-analytics and bluefin-pay traffic.

--- 12:08 UTC ---
raj: canary shows 70% drop in 502s for canary subset. full rollout in 2m if stable.
kevin: bypass toggled for allowlist. logs now show auth proxy responses no longer 503 for allowlisted projects.
sara: telemetry vendor acknowledged and says they're throttling in eu-west1 due to an internal control-plane issue. they estimate mitigation in 20-40m.
jamie-cs: relaying to customers: "We have a mitigation in flight routing traffic to alternate region; reduced errors seen in canary. Next update in 15m."
michelle: full rollout started. rolling additional pools over 6 minutes to avoid spike.
raj: monitor dashboards: ILB healthy backends returning to normal counts; cross-region queue length dropping.
kevin: watchlist commands used:
```
# check ILB backend health
kubectl -n infra logs ilb-health-aggregator | tail -n 50
# check controlplane policy
curl -sS 'https://controlplane.internal/v1/policies?customer=acme-analytics' | jq .
```

--- 12:30 UTC ---
raj: metrics stable. 5xxs down to baseline. no client-side reconnect storms.
sara: telemetry vendor status updated: degraded -> partial mitigated. they still have residual throttling in eu-west1 for non-critical API calls.
jamie-cs: Acme acknowledged the update and will monitor on their side; Bluefin requests postmortem, CS has logged.
michelle: prepping incident summary and customer impact notes. key points:
- root cause: third-party IDP + telemetry vendor API throttling in eu-west1 causing ILB control-plane auth failures and healthcheck flapping
- impact: select Private VPC customers in eu-west1 experienced increased 5xx and timeouts, traffic fell back to alternate regions for some connections
- mitigation: allowedlist-based auth fallback + region pinning; coordination with vendors; customer notifications
- action items: (1) formal postmortem, (2) add a control-plane fallback test in canary, (3) evaluate removing tight dependency on vendor API during LB control decisions
kevin: leaving a note for ops: consider circuit-breaker on upstream auth calls to avoid ILB draining on transient 503s.
raj: creating paging summary and tagging for postmortem: I'll include logs, command runbook, and the canary rollout timestamps.
oncall-bot: next oncall (sara) will be the primary in 2h for watch and postmortem follow-up.
michelle: i'm handing off to sara for the 2h watch. sara, anything else you want me to include in the handoff?
sara: all good. include the allowlist config and rollback steps. i'll drive the postmortem doc after the watch window.
jamie-cs: CS will prepare customer-facing postmortem drafts for Acme and Bluefin and coordinate with legal if needed.
michelle: incident marked resolved for routing and auth failures at 12:36 UTC. monitoring for regressions for 2h.

--- Incident notes end ---
